description: Source code for the LPS2XDF pressure and temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, data conversion, and API implementation.

methods.name: lps2xdf_odr_set
methods.description: Sets the output data rate (sampling frequency) for the sensor based on a predefined map.

methods.name: lps2xdf_attr_set
methods.description: Configures sensor attributes, currently supports setting sampling frequency.

methods.name: lps2xdf_press_convert
methods.description: Converts raw pressure data to sensor_value in kPa.

methods.name: lps2xdf_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value in degrees Celsius.

methods.name: lps2xdf_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves pressure or temperature data based on the sensor channel.
